conviction_note: A Q1 print with no forecast revision expected and shareholder returns already set in July (DOE 3% floor, 116 yen guided), so the release adds only the quarter; a mild positive lean from a conservative-guiding company entering the year on a +12.5% backlog, offset by a hard y/y comparison base, gives findings summing to +0.3 and a scaled number of (2*0.53-1)*6.0 = +0.36; the two agree in sign and size because both say near-nothing.
bar: Company H1 FY27 plan (OP 550m, ordinary 850m, i.e. ~275m OP per quarter run-rate) and FY plan (OP 2,600m / ordinary 2,800m) from the 2026-05 決算短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260714593677.pdf; street ordinary-profit consensus 3,100m from kabuyoho (one source, analyst count not shown) https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=6505. The market's own number is above the company plan, so a held plan is not a disappointment; the Q1 bar is soft because no quarterly consensus exists, hence findings capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 86.6x (kabutan, 2026-10-14) - margin longs dwarf margin shorts; irbank's last shown weekly margin long was 153,600 shares (2026-07-17, https://irbank.net/6505/margin), ~1.6% of shares and ~4-5 days of turnover, so crowded but not extreme. No options, no skew. Run-up -1.09% (20d), -0.51% (5d); stock flat 2,300-2,460 since the +17.5% July re-rating.

findings.finding: The company enters FY27 with an order backlog of 46,310m yen (+12.5% y/y; transport 36,479m, +14.7%) and FY26 orders +13.2%, against a sales guide of only +5.0% and an OP guide of -16.4%; it beat its initial guide in FY26 (initial ordinary 2,500m -> actual 3,520m) and revised up in April 2025, so the H1 OP plan of 550m (-18.8% y/y) looks like a soft bar for Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (released 2025-10-15 15:30) beat with ordinary 3.8x y/y and rallied +6.2% next day; Q2 FY26 missed the H1 plan and fell -8.3%; Q3 FY26 +15.1%; FY26 beat-and-raise-dividend +17.5%. Q1 FY25 (weak, OP 27m) moved -2.4%. This name pays for beats vs its own plan.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: street ordinary consensus (3,100m) already sits 11% above the company's 2,800m, so the conservatism is known at the FY level. What is not in the price is whether Q1 delivers it early - if the market held a Q1 beat it would have re-rated since July; instead the stock has drifted flat-to-down (-1% over 20 days) at PER ~8.7 and PBR 0.7.
findings.independence: Street consensus above the plan (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTop?bcode=6505) points the same way but is itself a reading of the same backlog and guidance history; the FY26 beat record is in the same 短信. Effectively one document.

findings.finding: Q1 FY26 is a hard comparison base (OP 367m, ordinary 533m including 200m of dividend income and 102m of securities-sale gains below that), equal to 67% of the whole FY27 H1 OP plan, so a Q1 near the plan's run-rate prints as a y/y profit decline in the kabutan headline that retail holders read first.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last y/y-decline headline, Q2 FY26 (2026-01-13, '上期経常は一転9％減益で下振れ着地'), fell -8.3% - but that was also a miss against the H1 plan, which a decline inside a lowered FY27 plan would not be.
findings.why_not_priced: The comparison is computable by anyone from two public 短信 and the company guided H1 OP -18.8% y/y, so a y/y decline is expected; what may not be priced is how a retail-heavy, margin-long register (信用倍率 86.6x) reacts to the headline wording rather than to the plan. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: H1 plan from the FY26 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260714593677.pdf), a different document from the Q1 FY26 base.

findings.finding: USD/JPY was flat across the quarter (159.64 on 2026-06-01, 159.75 on 2026-08-31) and CNY/JPY moved only 23.60 -> 23.75, so Q1 ordinary profit carries no material FX gain or loss (Q1 FY26 had +26m FX gain, Q1 FY25 a -79m loss).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FX has been a tens-of-millions line in the non-operating section; never the driver of a reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing to price: it removes a swing factor rather than adding one.

outside_window.finding: MTP 'Sustainable 2030' targets FY2030 OP 4,300m (vs FY27 guide 2,600m) and allots 40-60億 yen to shareholder returns including '機動的な自己株式の取得'; the interim dividend of 58 yen has a 2026-11-30 record date. A buyback is possible at any time but none is announced and the treasury stock was largely placed with JR East on 2026-08-06.

release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6505&b=n202610130958 (kabutan's 2026-10-13 list of 10-14 releases: '<6505> 東洋電 第1四半期決算 (前回16:00)'); last year's Q1 短信 was stamped 15:30 on 2025-10-15. Either way at/after the 15:30 close, so the window is the 10-14 close to the 10-15 close.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: not expected - this company has not revised at Q1 in the record kabutan shows (revisions came in January 2022 and April 2025), and the street already sits above the plan. Returns: already set in July (DOE 3% floor, 40% payout, interim 58 yen); a buyback is the only possible add and none is signalled. New-year guide: n/a at Q1. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 OP was 1.1% of FY in FY25 and 11.8% in FY26 (15% of the then-plan); the FY27 H1 OP plan is 550m, so Q1 OP above ~275m reads as on track.
baseline_tension: The priced lean is mildly negative (-0.91, all from the margin-long overhang) and the run-up flat; my findings net slightly positive, so they cut mildly against the lean. Strongest positive the release could carry: a Q1 well ahead of a deliberately low H1 plan (as in Q1 FY26, +6.2%) or a surprise buyback under the MTP's 機動的な自己株式の取得 - I looked for a buyback signal and found none.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 / y/y comparison anyone can compute from the last 短信): the hard-comparison-base finding cut from -0.8 to -0.5, and p_up moved from 52 to 53 since that negative now carries less weight; expected_move 0.24 -> 0.36.
Rule 2 (check the sign, write the strongest positive): done in baseline_tension; I had already looked for a buyback, so it moved nothing further.
The backlog finding and the FX finding were left standing.
